lead.headline: Ahead on game day; every starter clear
lead.deck: Wilson OUT and Pickens questionable, both on the bench; Green Bay's two questionable backs only help Jacobs.
lead.body: The bad news first, and it stays on the bench: Garrett Wilson is out with the concussion, and George Pickens is questionable with the hamstring after limited practices all week — Footballguys rate him likely to play, but he sits behind the projection lineup either way. No Sunday starter carries a designation as of 07:15 ET. Green Bay list both MarShawn Lloyd (knee) and Chris Brooks (ankle) questionable, which can only add to Josh Jacobs' share at New England, and Jonathan Taylor's trade talks have stalled at the Colts' price, so he plays Dallas. Bloodsports lead Jackrabbits 18.9 to 10.88; ESPN gives a 61% chance. Nothing to set — only the 10:30 and 13:55 CDMX inactive lists to look at.
